**Outcomes:** Inflation rebounded from negative figures observed since October 2023 [C013, C136]. As of August, year-on-year inflation reached 0.5 percent, with a 12-month average of -0.9 percent [C062]. In September, core inflation was -0.4 percent YOY [C024]. 

**Outlook:** Inflation is projected to remain moderate [C024]. For 2024, annual inflation is forecasted at 0.5 percent [C136], reaching 2.5 percent year-on-year and 0.5 percent on a 12-month average by December [C062]. Inflationary pressures are expected to rise in 2025 [C136].

**Drivers:** The rise is primarily driven by higher utility tariffs [C013, C136], currency depreciation [C013, C062, C136], and unwinding lower global fuel prices [C013]. Further pressures stem from a weaker Rupee, euro-dollar cross rates, and commodity price shocks [C136].
